prompts.summit:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production SNES-style pixel art parallax background layer sheet for a family platform game, Cloudberry Climb. Create ONE PNG 960 wide by 1620 high, exactly THREE equal horizontal panels stacked vertically, each 960x540 (16:9). No gutters, borders, labels, text, characters, collectibles, platforms or UI. Artwork should look authored at 320x180 per panel enlarged exactly 3x: deliberate chunky square pixel clusters, crisp stepped contours, a restrained 24-color palette, NO smooth painting, blur, fine texture or anti-aliasing.
TOP panel: fully opaque dramatic twilight lavender sky, broad mint aurora ribbons, distant rose cloud banks, tiny restrained stars. Calm readable middle, not noisy.
MIDDLE panel: isolated far mountain landscape on TRUE TRANSPARENCY above its silhouette: layered jagged blue-violet alpine peaks, glacier ravines, an impressive brass-domed observatory built into a distant snowy ridge, tiny warm windows, little cable railway. Scenery mainly lower 60% of this panel, upper area empty alpha. Muted medium values and low contrast. No sky.
BOTTOM panel: isolated nearer alpine foothills on TRUE TRANSPARENCY above silhouette: frosted firs, cliffside chalet roofs, abandoned expedition banners and snow-covered terraces concentrated in bottom 35%, sparse tall forms at side edges. Muted indigo/teal, warm window accents, readable large shapes. No sky. Each layer spans full width and is horizontally repeatable. Strong inhabited mountain identity with quiet central gameplay space. Real transparent pixels outside landscape shapes in panels 2 and 3; not a checkerboard illustration.
prompts.meadow: Production pixel-art parallax sheet for The Banana Coast, a cheerful Mediterranean family platform adventure. ONE PNG 960x1620, exactly THREE equal horizontal 960x540 panels stacked with no gaps or labels. Authored as chunky clean 320x180 SNES pixel art per panel enlarged 3x, crisp stepped shapes, limited palette, no smooth painting or fine noise. TOP: opaque apricot morning sky, cream clouds, turquoise sea and distant peach islands, calm middle. MIDDLE: on TRUE transparent sky, a beautiful distant Italian harbor town on the lower half: terracotta roofs, pastel stucco houses, clock tower, little sailboats, stone wharf, colorful but muted low-contrast. BOTTOM: on TRUE transparency above its silhouette, near coastal gardens and fruit market concentrated in bottom 30% and side edges: banana palms, striped canopy, crates, laundry, lemon trees, stone terrace. Strong sunny terracotta/turquoise identity. Middle gameplay area mostly empty transparency. Each layer full width horizontally repeatable. No people, text, UI, platforms, coins or interactive-looking objects. Real alpha outside scenery in lower two panels, opaque top panel.

The central 80% is a broad quiet dark desaturated teal moss clearing viewed FROM ABOVE, VERY low contrast and sparse detail, no blocking roots or props in center; no paths that imply gameplay, no water in center. Rich inhabited border, clear playable interior. Edge details occupy outermost 10-15% only. No characters, pickups, UI, writing, enemies, platforms. Entire image opaque, flat 2D overhead composition not an isometric illustration.
